text: On the authority of Abu Dharr, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, that he said: In the morning, every salaam (i.e. joint) of one of you has a sadaqah, so every tasbihah is a sadaqah, every tahmidah is a sadaqah, every tahlila is a sadaqa, every takbeer is a sadaqa, enjoining what is right is a sadaqa, and forbidding what is evil is a sadaqah, and two rak’ahs that he performs in the forenoon are sufficient for that.
